sub_agent_reviews.summary: One unified Scout was launched for llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety, timed out, and was closed; main process continued one merged manual candidate pass. First pick CodeSentinel duplicated a concurrent publish, so the run pivoted to same-table STARE.
Read arXiv API metadata, arXiv HTML full text, and the official STARE GitHub README for implementation and reproduction details.
Extracted GRPO entropy-gradient derivation, advantage-surprisal quadrants, near-criticality, O1/C2 reweighting, target-entropy gate, main results, ablations, and code entry points.
Article highlights task-scope limits, target-entropy transfer risk, reward-noise failure modes, reflection-token measurement limits, and reproduction cost.
Positioned STARE against DAPO, entropy regularization, trajectory-level weighting, fixed-threshold reweighting, and token-level credit assignment work cited by the paper.
Wrote pure Markdown with TL;DR, tables, formulas, pseudocode, and Mermaid; no external image URL is embedded.
